extracted.name: Chicken Stew 'Fricot'
extracted.description: This recipe for chicken stew with carrots and potatoes is seasoned with summer savory and easily accommodates the addition of dumplings.
ingredient_lines: 1 (2 to 3 pound) whole chicken, cut into pieces
instruction_lines: Melt butter in cooking pot, brown chicken with chopped onions. Add water to cover. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add carrots, potatoes, and savory. Simmer some more until vegetables are cooked. Salt and pepper to taste.
